summary: A fixed multiplier per size, per second while running, out of a plan whose dollars come back as machine time.

egress.note: The pricing FAQ says bandwidth is not billed.

notes: Storage counts against an included quota and is not billed; going over blocks new sandboxes.
Plans are per seat in an organisation.

upkeep.label: Updates not published
upkeep.detail: Sandboxes are kept, with coding agents preinstalled, and snapshots keep what you install. Who updates the system or the agents is not published.

source.quote: Every sandbox ships with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Kimi and Mistral Vibe.
